question.text: All the arrangements, with or without meaning, of the word <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>FARMER</mi></math> are written excluding any word that has two <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>R</mi></math> appearing together. The arrangements are listed serially in the alphabetic order as in the English dictionary. Then the serial number of the word <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>FARMER</mi></math> in this list is _____ .

solution.text:
Number of such words without both R together

= total possible words - total possible words with both R together

Number of such words start with A=5!2!-4!=36

Number of such words start with E=5!2!-4!=36

Number of such words start with FAE=3!2!-2=1

Number of such words start with FAM=3!2!-2=1

Number of such words start with FARE=2!=2

Number of such words start with FARMER=1

Total =77
